- The use is also functionally that of a demountable magnetic aid: it holds firmly while in place so a sharp freshly-ground edge can be handled safely without touching it, without leaving a permanent fixture on the blade.

That combination — hands only on rods, full weight carried through small flat face contacts, unchanged attachment through a large change in orientation, and one-handed support of the upright blade — leaves magnetic force as the attachment.
